name: Kin no Hoshi Furu Yoru
source:
This is a doujin game about the second season of D.Gray-*an.

They were supposed to quietly watch the stars tonight.
But Al*n ended up searching for Tim Cam*i, who disappeared.
Something is happening on the night the golden star came down.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037743.html]DLsite English[/url]]
